full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of small intestinal mucosa showing flattened, blunted villi. The enterocytes lining the villi display changes such as cuboidal transformation and intraepithelial lymphocytosis. The lamina propria contains a dense inflammatory infiltrate. These histological findings are characteristic of celiac disease resulting in total or subtotal villous atrophy.

random.description: This image is a photomicrograph of small intestinal mucosa showing flattened or blunted villi characteristic of celiac disease. The tissue section reveals significant mucosal changes, including villous atrophy and intraepithelial lymphocytosis. These histological alterations are typical of gluten-sensitive enteropathy. The view highlights the structural degradation of the intestinal absorptive surface.
